meta.method: Each home page (and the price/menu page where noted) was fetched with WebFetch, which returns text converted from the HTML. Layout, imagery, type and stickiness cannot be seen this way. Every 'looks_good' sentence is INFERRED from the text structure and the site's reputation or curation, not from a rendered view. 'null' means not visible in the fetched text.
meta.selection_notes: 12 real businesses and 8 templates. Real businesses: 2 from the Squarespace showcase (Andamiro, Stretch Squared), 1 from Zarla's salon inspiration list (Strange Bird), 2 from Site Builder Report's contractor inspiration list (Anderson Plumbing, Kato Electrical), 1 named in dental-design roundups (Grand Street Dental), and 6 chosen from general reputation (Che Fico, Lilia, Dishoom, Spoke & Weal, Hairroin, Tia, Barry's, Psycle; Hairroin was found through a price-list search). Templates: Framer Marketplace previews (Elysia, OraCare, Dentelle, Planto, Yogara) and a Webflow template preview (Plumbing X). Trades have no strong real examples on award sites, so 2 of 4 are templates. Rejected because they did not load as text: skyting.com (403), hellotend.com (403), y7-studio.com and dentologie.com (JS only), hummingpuppy.com (nav only), terremoto.la (empty), ninezeroone.com and mechesalon.com and laughinglotus.com and formapilates.com (certificate errors), butterflystudiosalon.com (under construction), fatchoynyc.com (404).
